definition: Unchanged seed and no document prior. raw = line_glyphs.band.bottom across every crop column; columns = main band.bottom in each column_segments segment, mean absolute difference at crop coordinates fitted in both runs. Split gaps are excluded and coverage is recorded.

changes.visual_assessment: Improved: the start rises to the clipped first word instead of underlining neighbouring ink.
Indeterminate without a prior: the 26 px crop estimates a 9 px x-height. With the document 26 px prior the mean change is 2.51 px.
Improved: the rising start follows the first words of the main line rather than the line below.
Improved: the left-hand curve follows the first word and joins the rest of the line smoothly.
Improved: the right-hand curl follows the raised final word; the body remains on its baseline.
Improved: the left column now follows its curled first word; the right column remains separately fitted.
Improved: the baseline sits closer to the letter bottoms; it no longer starts below the first word.
